scenes.stage_direction: The search becomes a confrontation with named decision-makers. Each signed record changes a concrete next step.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: The official accepts that Adrian acknowledged Ethan as his son.

dialogues.speaker: Amara
dialogues.text: He was his son before the official accepted it.

dialogues.speaker: David
dialogues.text: Kellan's representative has raised another objection. We will ask for it in writing.

metadata.evidence_summary: Adrian's relationship to Ethan is accepted.
